display.purpose: Page titles and restaurant names only -- the one serif moment, never body copy or UI chrome.

body.purpose: All functional text: descriptions, forms, nav, buttons, metadata.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Quietest resting elevation, rarely used alone.

shadows.name: standard
shadows.purpose: Default depth for buttons and cards that carry some rest-state shadow.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Hover/active state -- modals, dropdowns, a hovered restaurant card.

motion.name: ease-confident
motion.purpose: Interaction feedback -- card hover lift, photo zoom, confident deceleration with no overshoot.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Authored entrance animations -- card stagger-in, modal drop-in, bar fill, save confirmation.

motion.name: duration-immediate
motion.purpose: Icon buttons, links, filter controls -- direct feedback to a click or hover.

motion.name: duration-photo
motion.purpose: Restaurant card photo hover-zoom -- tuned to move together with the card's own 180ms lift, not lag behind it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled terracotta pill button -- the only button style with a persistent background fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #d95030); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; min-height: 44px; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #c44528); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(26,24,20,0.07); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d95030); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button (Google sign-in)
components.description: White pill button borrowing Google's own brand colors -- the one deliberate exception to the app's own palette.
components.css: .ds-btn-google { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #3c4043; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #dadce0; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-google:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Restaurant Card
components.description: Photography-first card: flat at rest, lifts with shadow and a subtle photo zoom on hover.
components.html:
Restaurant Name

Neighborhood · Cuisine · $$
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-card, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(26,24,20,0.08)); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(26,24,20,0.10); } .ds-card-photo-wrap { overflow: hidden; height: 200px; } .ds-card-photo { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-photo { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text, #1a1814); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #6b6560); }

components.name: Archetype Chip
components.description: Earned badge, not decoration -- only appears when the restaurant clears a real quantile rule.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(217,80,48,0.08); color: #c0451f; border: none; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Warm-sand field with an accent focus ring, no default browser outline.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg-subtle, #f0ece7); color: var(--text, #1a1814); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(26,24,20,0.08)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #d95030); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(217,80,48,0.08); }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Sticky nav; active page carries weight and color, never an underline or pill mark. Signed-out visitors see a persistent Google sign-up pill after the nav links.
components.html:
Locals
RecsSavedVisitedAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--bg, #faf8f5); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(26,24,20,0.08)); position: sticky; top: 0; } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--text, #1a1814); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #6b6560); text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-nav-link-active { font-weight: 500; color: var(--text, #1a1814); }

components.name: Modal / Flow Overlay
components.description: Shared construction for every modal in the app (rating flow, sign-in prompt, account dropdown) -- portal-rendered, one authored entrance keyframe.
components.html: Sign in to save restaurants
components.css: .ds-modal-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; } .ds-modal-card { width: 100%; max-width: 24rem; background: var(--bg-card, #fff); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(26,24,20,0.10); animation: ds-modal-drop 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1) both; } @keyframes ds-modal-drop { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(0.97); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } } .ds-modal-title { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--text, #1a1814); margin-bottom: 20px; }

narrative.overview: Locals is built around the feeling of the seat a regular always gets at their neighborhood spot -- warm, familiar, quietly earned rather than announced. The system leans editorial (The Infatuation, Eater) over platform-generic: photography carries the argument, type sets the tone, and chrome stays out of the way. Every trust signal on the page -- an archetype badge, a localness bar, a "locals rate it 4.4 vs. tourists' 3.8" verdict -- is treated as something that was earned through a real, inspectable rule, never applied as decoration. The palette is warm and sun-worn (terracotta, cream, muted gold) rather than the cool, saturated primaries of a typical consumer-app template, and it explicitly rejects Yelp and TripAdvisor's registers: no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no badges that don't mean something specific. Depth is used sparingly and only in response to interaction -- the interface is flat by default and only lifts when a person is actually engaging with it.
keyCharacteristics: Photography-first card grid; the food photo is the hero, the UI frames it
Warm, sun-worn palette (terracotta / cream / muted gold) instead of platform-generic primaries
Serif display type (DM Serif Display) paired with a humanist sans body (Plus Jakarta Sans)
Pill-shaped buttons and tags throughout; no sharp corners anywhere in the system
Flat-at-rest surfaces that gain shadow and lift only on hover/interaction
Every badge, score, and verdict traces back to a real computed rule, never decoration

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sunbaked Terracotta is the only color allowed to mean "act here." Muted Gold and Confirmation Green each carry one narrow, specific meaning and never substitute for the primary accent.

rules.name: The Dark-Mode Warmth Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is not a desaturated inversion -- every warm hue shifts brighter and slightly more saturated to stay warm under low light rather than going cold and gray.

rules.name: The One Serif Moment Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display appears only where the brand is speaking directly -- a page title or a restaurant's own name -- never in a button, a metadata line, or a form field.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow only appears in response to state -- hover, focus, an open dropdown. A surface that shows the same shadow whether or not anyone is touching it is a mistake, not a stylistic choice.

rules.name: The No Sharp Corners Rule
rules.body: Every rectangle in the interface is rounded at 8px or more; every action (button, tag, chip) is a full pill. A 0px-radius rectangle reads as a spreadsheet, not a neighborhood.

dos: Do keep the photo as the largest, first thing a person sees on any card or detail page -- UI elements frame it, they never sit on top of it in a way that obscures it.
Do use the full pill radius (9999px) for every button, tag, and badge; use 8-16px for every rectangular container.
Do let shadow and lift communicate interactivity -- apply the Lifted shadow only on hover/active states, never at rest.
Do back every badge, score, or "verdict" sentence with a real, recomputable rule against the live dataset.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling transform/transition/animation app-wide, not just the large ones.
donts: Don't use gradient text for emphasis -- weight and size carry emphasis in this system.
Don't add glassmorphism or blur-as-decoration; the one backdrop blur in the system exists to keep small white text legible over a busy photo, not for atmosphere.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color for a new feature -- Muted Gold and Confirmation Green are already spoken for.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing on any transition; every authored motion in this system decelerates confidently and never overshoots.
Don't show an archetype badge, "verified," or trust indicator that isn't backed by an inspectable rule -- an empty state (no badge at all) is correct and expected for most restaurants.
